tasks.title: Announcement #14
tasks.instruction: Listen to a school principal talking to a group of students.
tasks.transcript: May I have your attention, please? We want to inform you that we will be hosting our second college visit trip with the students leaving next Friday and returning next Sunday. This trip will be limited to 35 students on a first come first serve basis. We will be traveling to San Diego and will make our way back up to Oxnard visiting colleges in-between. Come to the office to make the reservation and payment is due immediately to reserve your student's place.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the talk?

options.A: To inform students about a trip
options.B: To explain the application for colleges
options.C: To show an alternative destination for a field trip
options.D: To help students reserve seats on a school bus

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这段讲话的目的，属于主旨/目的理解题，需抓住校长整段话的核心内容。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 校长明确告知将举办第二次大学参观旅行，并说明了出发时间（下周五）、返回时间（下周日）、人数限制（35人）、行程路线（圣地亚哥至奥克斯纳德）以及报名方式，整段话的目的是通知学生关于这次旅行的信息。 选项B：错误。 讲话中提到参观大学，但并未解释大学申请的相关事宜，属于无关信息。 选项C：错误。 讲话中没有提到其他备选目的地，只是告知本次旅行的具体安排。 选项D：错误。 校长提到需要到办公室预约并立即付款，但讲话的目的不是帮助学生预约校车座位，而是通知旅行信息。

questions.stem: What point does principal say about the trip?

options.A: Students don’t have to pay for the trip.
options.B: Students need to pay for the trip immediately after reservation.
options.C: Students will only visit universities in two cities.
options.D: The principal will lead the trip.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问校长关于这次旅行提到的要点，属于细节理解题，需抓住校长对旅行要求的具体说明。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 校长明确说“payment is due immediately”，说明学生需要支付费用，而非免费。 选项B：正确。 校长明确说“Come to the office to make the reservation and payment is due immediately to reserve your student's place”，即预约后需要立即付款才能保留名额。 选项C：错误。 校长说会前往圣地亚哥，然后一路返回奥克斯纳德，途中参观多所大学，并非只参观两个城市的大学。 选项D：错误。 讲话中没有说明谁将带队，属于无中生有。
